headline: US futures point to a mixed open as rotation out of AI and chip stocks continues ahead of labor data and Fed speeches
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) are down 0.11%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) are up 0.51%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) are off 1.00%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) are up 0.28%, underscoring relative tech weakness versus Dow components and small caps
- FIS (FIS) trades roughly flat pre-market after cutting 2026 guidance and warning of a 2027 EPS decline despite a Q3 beat
- DOX (DOX) edges higher in pre-market trading after cutting FY27 outlook on a contractual T-Mobile dispute, with Oppenheimer downgrading the stock
- NRIX (NRIX) trades modestly higher pre-market as Sanofi terminates its STAT6 degrader program and analysts cut price targets
- Estee Lauder (EL) trades roughly flat after analysts raise price targets following a fiscal Q1 beat and new 2030 financial goals, while Rivian (RIVN) slips modestly after raised guidance and upgrade-related catalysts
- Parker-Hannifin (PH), Cigna (CI), Cummins (CMI), Duke Energy (DUK), Zoetis (ZTS), and Rockwell Automation (ROK) report earnings before the bell, with beats or misses versus estimates expected to drive early moves
- At 8:30 AM ET, markets will receive initial jobless claims, continuing claims, nonfarm productivity, and unit labor costs data
- Fed speeches from Hammack and Barkin later in the morning could introduce additional rate-related volatility
- Asian trading is mixed with notable weakness in chip-related stocks in South Korea and Japan, while European markets advance
- Oil (@CL) holds near recent lower levels as gold futures (@GC) continue to climb into the US session
